Processing Invoices for Payment

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 6 of 15).
MSU A/P: Invoice Requirements
The MSU Accounts Payable team (A/P, msuap@morgan.edu) is responsible for processing vendor invoices for payment via the State of Maryland. Below are the necessary components of a vendor invoice.
Vendor Name Tax Federal ID Number (SSN or FEIN) Invoice # Invoice Date Bill-To Address Should be addressed to MSU directly. PI can be listed as attn. MSU Purchase Order # (PO#) The PO must be completed and approved by Procurement before A/P will process the invoice. Remittance Address
Complete the content above before moving on.
OK to Pay: Processing Invoices for Payment
To process an invoice through MSU A/P you must mark the invoice as "Ok to Pay" (see left). This authorizes the invoice to be processed and should include the full name and signature of the individual authorized to submit invoices for the project, the date of submission, and purchase order #. Once marked, the "OK to Pay" invoice copy, and the original, should be emailed to approved-invoices.msuap@morgan.edu for payment processing.
Please Note: Invoices from international vendors may require different invoice information compared to domestic vendors. Please contact the MSU Accounts Payable team for guidance.
